name: banpie-daily-chief
description: 半撇每日参谋：本地优先、宿主无关的每日规划工具

scripts.build: node scripts/sync-plugin-skills.mjs && npm run build -w @banpie/daily-chief-core && npm run build -w @banpie/daily-chief-web && npm run build -w @banpie/daily-chief-cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @banpie/daily-chief-core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run validate:artifacts
